item.text:
### Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must act now to prevent that future.

2. We believe this plainly: Build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. We must put safety and accountability first.

3. Superintelligent AI built in the next 20 years will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We cannot treat this as an acceptable risk. We must prevent it.

### Newsletter opening

We face a defining choice. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. This is not a distant abstraction or a risk we can afford to set aside while development races ahead. We must confront what is at stake, demand accountability from those building and deploying these systems, and press decision-makers to put public safety first. The choices made now will shape whether this technology becomes a source of catastrophe. We are working for a future in which the drive to build ever more powerful AI does not outrun our ability to protect people.
